column1: # Tour executor candidate-product binding contract.
# Sprint 118 / Story #4 / Story-ID 759341a95870.
# WHAT AUTHENTICATES A CANDIDATE. The manager-supplied build manifest, verbatim:
#   TOUR_CANDIDATE_MANIFEST=<...>/sprint118-evidence/<candidate>/candidate.json
# tools/tour/executor-runner.rb passes that JSON to Corpus.authenticate_candidate
# (tools/corpus/executor.rb, W2 / Story-ID e29305614139), which verifies the
# launcher digest, the adjacent `.real` payload digest, and that EVERY listed
# repository is at the stated revision with a clean tree including untracked
# files. Authentication failure aborts the run; it is not a warning.
# TWO SUPERSEDED RULES.
#   1. tour-evidence/v2 required a PUBLISHED RELEASE TAG (tools/tour/evidence-runner.rb
#      aborts unless `bashy --version` reports `-bashy-<tag>`), so a Makefile
#      build could not be tested without cutting a release. A tag is now
#      recorded when present but is neither required nor sufficient.
#   2. The first tour-executor/v1 draft DERIVED each component commit by
#      resolving sibling worktrees by convention and comparing them to the
#      commit stamped in `bashy --version`. That relates the binary to whatever
#      happens to be checked out next to it, which is not a binding at all. The
#      manifest is the binding; this table only declares WHICH components must
#      appear in it.
# THE PAIR. On linux/darwin `make build-bashy` emits two files (bashy/Makefile):
#   <BIN>       the native siglaunch launcher, compiled from native/siglaunch.c.in
#   <BIN>.real  the Go payload, `go build -trimpath -ldflags ... ./cmd/bashy`
# Both digests are in the manifest and both are verified. Binding only the
# launcher leaves the interpreter unbound; binding only the payload leaves the
# executed entry point unbound.
# THE REPLACED DEPENDENCIES. bashy's go.mod replaces its parser, userland,
# line editor and file-management surface with sibling worktrees whose commits
# the binary does NOT embed:
#   replace mvdan.cc/sh/v3                     => ../sh
#   replace github.com/qiangli/coreutils       => ../coreutils
#   replace github.com/ergochat/readline       => ../readline
#   replace github.com/filebrowser/filebrowser/v2 => ../filebrowser
# All four are listed below and all four must be bound. `filebrowser` is easy to
# miss because it enters `require` as an indirect dependency and is replaced
# anyway; an unbound replaced dependency is unauthenticated product code, so the
# gate additionally rejects any manifest repository that is NOT declared here.
# `frozen_commit` is empty until the sprint manager freezes the integrated
# revision set; once filled, the gate enforces equality against the manifest.
# component
bashy
sh
coreutils
readline
filebrowser
